title: Strengthen causal persistence witness with exact evidence and both live-view isolation checks
outcome: The causal projection regression witness detects altered persisted evidence and verifies live/public isolation after both SQLite and full JSON serialization.
acceptance: The witness compares normalized SQL and full JSON causalFailure data with the original expected serialized cause fields, so altered or empty causal evidence fails.
After full JSON serialization, the original live cause remains pending and its public serialization still omits causalFailure; existing SQLite, unrelated-tick and reload checks remain meaningful.
